officialLinks.label: Grades, GPA formula, grade points, P/NP/S/U/I/IP exclusions
Transfer credit and transcript GPA treatment

helpIntro: UC Davis uses a 4.0 UC GPA scale: A+ and A are 4.0, plus/minus grades change by 0.3, and F is 0. Enter GPA-applicable UC quarter units and final letter grades to estimate your current or projected GPA.
helpNote: P/NP, S/U, I, IP and other non-grade-point marks are excluded from ordinary GPA. Non-UC transfer grades do not enter the UC GPA. Repeat Impact is disabled because undergraduate replacement is limited to the first 16 eligible repeated units and transcript context matters.
helpExample: A 4-unit A- earns 14.8 grade points. A 4-unit B+ earns 13.2. Together, 28.0 ÷ 8 = 3.500.

gradeExplanations.A+: A+ = 4.0 points per unit, same as A.
gradeExplanations.F: F = 0 points; letter-graded units remain in the GPA denominator unless excluded by an approved repeat.
gradeExplanations.P: Passed; units may earn credit but do not enter GPA.
gradeExplanations.NP: Not Passed; no grade points and excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.S: Satisfactory graduate grading; excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.U: Unsatisfactory graduate grading; excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.I: Incomplete is excluded from ordinary GPA while pending; special graduation/standing rules can differ.
gradeExplanations.IP: In Progress is excluded until replaced by a final grade.
gradeExplanations.NG: No Grade notation; excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.Y: Pending judicial/remediation notation; excluded from ordinary GPA.
gradeExplanations.NS: No grade submitted notation; excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.H: Honors notation listed without grade points; excluded from GPA.

specialTypes.name: UC Davis or other UC letter-graded course
specialTypes.note: Use GPA-applicable letter-graded UC coursework. Other UC campus work contributes to the overall UC GPA.

specialTypes.name: UC Davis Continuing and Professional Education
specialTypes.note: Only GPA-applicable UC Davis CPE/Extension work that appears in UC totals should be entered.

specialTypes.name: Non-UC transfer course
specialTypes.note: Non-UC transfer credit may count toward degree units but does not enter the cumulative UC GPA.

specialTypes.name: Course affected by repeat rules
specialTypes.note: Use your official transcript repeat annotation or adviser guidance. The first 16 eligible undergraduate repeated units can replace prior GPA work; later/partial-limit cases can count both attempts.

specialTypes.name: Professional-school course
specialTypes.note: Law, Medicine, Veterinary Medicine, and other professional-school grading may follow separate rules; use the school record and adviser guidance.

repeatPolicy.note: Repeat Impact is disabled. Use the official transcript repeat annotations or adviser guidance before adjusting a cumulative GPA baseline.
